title.zh: 天空光是被空气拐弯的阳光
title.en: Skylight is sunlight scattered by air

description.zh: 天空本身不发光；整层空气拐走约 20% 的蓝光、约 5% 的红光，落到地面的那一半就是天空的光。
description.en: The sky gives off no light of its own: the whole air column scatters about 20% of blue light and 5% of red, and the half that comes down is the skylight.

zh: 月球上的天为什么是黑的
为什么从太空看地球边缘是蓝的
en: why is the sky black on the moon
blue edge of the earth from space

description.zh: 比光波小得多的粒子里，电子被光推着晃，发出的光强与频率的四次方成正比，所以 450 纳米蓝光的散射约是 700 纳米红光的 6 倍。
description.en: In a particle far smaller than the wavelength, light shakes the electrons and they re-radiate with power rising as frequency to the fourth, so 450 nm blue scatters about 6× more than 700 nm red.

en: why does blue light scatter more

title.zh: 天空光的光谱峰在紫外
title.en: The skylight spectrum peaks in the ultraviolet

description.zh: 把黑体阳光的光谱乘上 1/λ⁴，模型里的最强处从约 500 纳米挪到紫外（真实阳光的紫外到地面前已被臭氧吸收）；可见范围内，紫光段的能量多于蓝光段。
description.en: Multiply a blackbody solar spectrum by 1/λ⁴ and in the model its peak moves from about 500 nm into the ultraviolet (real ultraviolet is absorbed by ozone before reaching the ground); in the visible range violet carries more energy than blue.

title.zh: 为什么天不是紫的：眼睛的三种视锥
title.en: Why the sky isn't violet: the eye's three cones

description.zh: 眼睛只报告三种视锥各被激发多少；紫光段带来 44% 的能量却只贡献约 1% 的亮度，整片光谱读出来是掺了白的蓝（主波长 476 纳米）。
description.en: The eye reports only how much each of three cone types is excited; violet brings 44% of the energy but about 1% of the brightness, and the whole spectrum reads as a whitish blue (dominant wavelength 476 nm).

zh: 为什么天空不是紫色的
en: why is the sky not violet

title.zh: 落日为什么是红的：大气质量
title.en: Why sunsets are red: air mass

description.zh: 太阳越低，光在空气里走的路越长（贴着地平线约 38 倍），蓝光被拐走得最多，剩下橙红。
description.en: The lower the sun, the longer the path through air (about 38× at the horizon); blue is removed first and orange-red is left.

title.en: Deepest blue overhead, white at the horizon

description.zh: 看向地平线时视线很长，拐进来的蓝光又在半路被拐走，颜色趋向照亮空气的阳光本身；远山发淡发白是同一回事（空气透视）。
description.en: Looking at the horizon the line of sight is long, so blue scattered in is scattered out again and the colour tends to that of the sunlight itself; distant hills fade the same way (aerial perspective).

zh: 天空为什么越靠近地平线越淡
en: why is the sky white near the horizon
why do distant mountains look blue

title.zh: 米氏散射：云为什么是白的
title.en: Mie scattering: why clouds are white

description.zh: 颗粒比光波大得多时（云滴约 4–17 微米），各种颜色被散射得差不多一样多；和光波差不多大时，散射起伏，甚至偏爱红光，让太阳发蓝。
description.en: Once particles are far larger than the wavelength (cloud drops are about 4–17 µm), all colours scatter about equally; near the wavelength the scattering oscillates and can even favour red, turning the sun blue.

title.zh: 火星的天空：黄褐的白天、蓝色的日落
title.en: The Martian sky: butterscotch by day, blue at sunset

description.zh: 火星空气太稀（440 纳米的瑞利光学厚度约 0.01），天空颜色由微米级、吸收蓝光的尘埃决定；尘埃把蓝光向前散射，日落时太阳附近发蓝。
description.en: The Martian air is too thin (Rayleigh optical depth about 0.01 at 440 nm), so micron-sized dust that absorbs blue sets the sky colour; the dust scatters blue forward, so the sky near the setting sun is blue.

zh: 火星的天空是什么颜色
火星日落为什么是蓝的
en: what colour is the sky on Mars
why is the sunset blue on Mars
why is a dust storm sky yellow

title.zh: 多次散射与臭氧：简单模型漏掉的
title.en: Multiple scattering and ozone: what the simple model misses

description.zh: 天顶约四分之一的蓝光被拐过不止一次；黄昏时天顶仍然是蓝的，主要靠臭氧 Chappuis 带的吸收（太阳在地平线时约占 66%）。
description.en: About a quarter of the blue zenith light has been scattered more than once; the zenith stays blue at twilight mainly because of ozone's Chappuis-band absorption (about 66% with the sun at the horizon).

zh: 黄昏的天为什么是蓝的
en: why is the twilight sky blue

reason.zh: 第 3 章把太阳的普朗克谱乘上第 2 章的 1/λ⁴，得到天空光的光谱，它的峰值落在紫外。
reason.en: Chapter 3 multiplies the Sun’s Planck spectrum by chapter 2’s 1/λ⁴ to get the skylight spectrum, whose peak lies in the ultraviolet.

label.en: Handing the spectrum to the eye

reason.zh: 第 4 章把第 3 章的天空光光谱交给三种视锥：一段宽的光谱被看成发白的蓝，而不是紫。
reason.en: Chapter 4 passes chapter 3’s skylight spectrum through the three cones: a broad spectrum is seen as a whitish blue, not violet.

reason.zh: 第 6 章沿用第 5 章的道理：路径越长蓝光被拿走得越多；靠近地平线的视线很长，散射光也失去蓝色而发白。
reason.en: Chapter 6 reuses chapter 5’s point that a longer path removes more blue: lines of sight near the horizon are long, so even the scattered light loses its blue and turns white.

label.zh: 瑞利是米氏的小粒子极限

reason.zh: 第 7 章：米氏散射描述任意大小的球形颗粒，第 2 章的瑞利散射是它在颗粒很小时的极限，所以天的蓝和云的白是同一个公式的两端。
reason.en: Chapter 7: Mie scattering covers spheres of any size and chapter 2’s Rayleigh scattering is its limit for small particles, so the sky’s blue and the clouds’ white are two ends of one formula.

reason.zh: 第 8 章用第 6 章的单次散射天空，换成火星的稀薄空气再加上尘埃，得到黄褐的白天和蓝色的日落。
reason.en: Chapter 8 runs chapter 6’s single-scattering sky with Mars’ thin air plus dust, giving a butterscotch day and a blue sunset.

reason.zh: 第 9 章用第 1 章的光子蒙特卡罗，数到达地面的散射光子各被散射了几次，看单次散射图像漏掉了什么。
reason.en: Chapter 9 reuses chapter 1’s photon Monte Carlo to count how many times each diffuse photon reaching the ground was scattered, showing what the single-scattering picture leaves out.

reason.zh: 第 3 章：太阳表面约 5772 K，按黑体辐射规律在 500 nm 附近最强；这条曲线从哪里来见黑体辐射页。
reason.en: Chapter 3: the Sun’s surface is about 5772 K and by the blackbody law its light peaks near 500 nm; where this curve comes from is on the Blackbody Radiation page.

reason.zh: 第 7 章：米氏散射曲线中间的起伏，来自光绕过颗粒的不同路径彼此干涉，见“波的干涉”。
reason.en: Chapter 7: the bumps in the middle of the Mie curve come from light taking different paths around a particle and interfering, see Interference.
